description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and a class related to managing document storage, including document store metadata, file chunks, loaders, and related operations within a document management system.

classes.name: DocumentStoreDTO
classes.description: Data transfer object class for DocumentStore entity, providing methods to convert from entity to DTO and vice versa, and to parse and aggregate loader data.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Creates a DocumentStoreDTO instance from a DocumentStore entity, parsing JSON fields and setting source information for loaders.

methods.name: fromEntities
methods.description: Creates an array of DocumentStoreDTO instances from an array of DocumentStore entities.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a plain object into a DocumentStore entity, initializing loaders and whereUsed fields, and setting default status.
